title: Sessions cold-start preflight ignores process-live outbound streaming capability

observed.message: target does not support required capability bounded_response_stream_v1

expected: A local sessions artifact generated and served with SNAPBACK_OUTBOUND_ACTIONS=1 admits bounded_response_stream_v1, as the shipped sessions and streamed-actions guide pages jointly claim.

sourceInspection.finding: The sessions preflight constructs CapabilityManifest::local_v0_declared(), while process inspection/callable loading uses the process-live outbound gate.

workaroundProbe.attempt: start a narrow sessions carrier, then admin-load the full manifest

impact: A sessions-mode application cannot combine authenticated principals with bounded streamed actions on the local target.
Research Room cannot prove authenticated progress, collaborator observation, cancellation, or settlement at the frozen commit.
The failure occurs at deployment admission, before application data or secrets exist.
proposedOutcome: Capability admission for a sessions candidate must resolve against the same process-live target declaration used by /inspect and ordinary function loading, without weakening the closed startup pair or auth-mode transition fence.
